items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of resident parking permit
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Beispielingen, Marktstraße 2, 70597 Beispielingen.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 06.08.2025, sent by ordinary post by an authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (Landesverwaltungsverfahrensrecht BW), it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Sun 10.08.2025; this deemed-delivery day is not shifted for a Sunday. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. 11.08.2025, and ends one month later on 10.09.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 10.09.2025 is a Wednesday, a normal working day in Baden-Württemberg, so no further shift applies. The Widerspruch must reach the authority by this date (not just be sent).

warnings: The deemed-delivery date (10.08.2025, four days after the 06.08.2025 posting date) is calculated assuming the letter was actually posted on its printed date; if it was posted later, the deadline shifts later accordingly.
No fee is charged for this decision, so the IBAN printed in the letter footer is not relevant to this letter and should not be used to send any payment in response to it.
